title: Chest pairs: same-patient radiograph and CT
description: Same-patient chest radiograph + CT pairs. COVID-19-AR: three patients with a diagnostic frontal radiograph and an axial chest CT (same day, or 3 days apart, from consistently shifted dates); CT localizers are kept with role 'scout' to contrast with real radiographs, and one vendor coronal MPR is included as a labelled extra. LIDC-IDRI: three patients with CT plus CR/DX and multi-reader nodule outlines (>=3 mm, outlined by >=2 of 4 readers) from the official LIDC XML; LIDC dates are placeholders, so the CT-radiograph interval is unknown. Includes one CT series kept in its original uncompressed transfer syntax.

referenceTargets.label: Lung nodule 1 (LIDC, outlined by 4/4 readers)

provenanceDetail.source: tcia:LIDC-IDRI (Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI), doi:10.7937/K9/TCIA.2015.LO9QL9SX) — XML member 'tcia-lidc-xml/157/158.xml' of LIDC-XML-only.zip (sha256 644557a3aa305602...)
provenanceDetail.method: LIDC XML unblindedReadNodule outlines (edgeMap xCoord=column, yCoord=row, zero-based pixel indices) kept per reader as image_px planes; matched to CT slices by imageSOP_UID; inclusion=FALSE rois stored as holes. Cross-reader grouping by this pipeline: outlines of different readers linked when filled outlines overlap or contour points are within 3.30 mm, strongest overlap first, never merging two outlines of the same reader (greedy union-find). Per LIDC convention the outline is drawn just outside the nodule margin.
provenanceDetail.note: Consensus: outlined (>=3 mm nodule) by 4 of 4 readers. Approx. longest in-plane extent per reader outline (derived from outline points, mm): [19.5, 27.7, 28.0, 20.6]. Centroid (LPS mm) ~[49.0, 37.6, 1479.8].

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: LIDC-IDRI readers (4, two-phase blinded/unblinded) marked nodules >=3 mm (outlined), nodules <3 mm (centre mark only) and non-nodules >=3 mm across the whole CT. Only nodules >=3 mm outlined by >=2 readers are targets here (3). Not targets: 1 outlined nodule(s) seen by only one reader, 13 <3 mm nodule mark(s), 12 non-nodule mark(s). Other findings and anatomy are unassessed.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: LIDC readers' malignancy ratings for this nodule: [3, 4, 5, 3] (scale 1-5). These are subjective suspicion ratings by radiologists who had no pathology or follow-up information — they are NOT diagnoses. Outlines differ between readers; compare them rather than treating any one as ground truth.
